The strongest within-site linear signal was sodium_mmol (p≈0.048), which I locked and tested with the pre-registered confirmatory OLS on held-out data. The confirmatory test gave estimate 0.098 (SE 0.124), p=0.43, not significant at alpha=0.05. Therefore no direct effect was confirmed.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import statsmodels.api as sm
df = pd.read_csv('data/explore.csv')
exposures = ['vitamin_d','sleep_hours','steps_k','bmi','crp_level','dose_mg','age_decades','sodium_mmol','hdl','stress_index']
d = df.dropna().copy()
print("site outcome means:", d.groupby('hospital')['recovery_score'].mean().to_dict())
Xh = sm.add_constant(pd.get_dummies(d['hospital'], drop_first=True).astype(float))
mh = sm.OLS(d['recovery_score'], Xh).fit()
print("R2 site only:", mh.rsquared, "resid sd:", mh.resid.std())
print()
for e in exposures:
    # pooled
    Xp = sm.add_constant(d[[e]])
    mp = sm.OLS(d['recovery_score'], Xp).fit()
    # within site
    mw = sm.OLS(d['recovery_score'], sm.add_constant(pd.concat([d[[e]], pd.get_dummies(d['hospital'],drop_first=True).astype(float)],axis=1))).fit()
    print(f"{e:14s} pooled b={mp.params[e]: .3f} p={mp.pvalues[e]:.3f} | within b={mw.params[e]: .3f} p={mw.pvalues[e]:.3f}")
print()
print("exposure means by site:")
print(d.groupby('hospital')[exposures].mean().round(2))
